Each cell keeps the entire visible adult character plus visible steering wheel/kart only; close-up hair/body may touch original cell edges. Preserve EXACT character poses, hand/arm anatomy, golden spiky hair/fabric details, scratchy black crosshatching/stipple/gritty card style, bloodshot eyes/teeth/sweat, orange gi/navy clothing and progressive gritted-teeth to screaming acting. REMOVE ALL backdrop and effects to alpha: sky, flat city skyline, palms, bridges, road/asphalt, magenta/yellow scenery/splatter/marks, golden aura/energy/lightning strokes, smoke, spray, sparks and detached decorative marks. No ground, floor, shadow or glow. Keep character skin/hair/clothes/attached body details and mechanical kart opaque; cutout holes around hands/wheel and between hair silhouette are transparent where they show background.
Output a clean RGBA cutout sprite sheet with genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside whole character+kart. No checkerboard pattern baked into pixels, no white/black/colored opaque matte, no backdrop, no new cast shadows. Keep the grid and every frame's original placement unchanged. Only remove background and atmospheric effects; do not redraw style or change composition.
